name: @oh-my-pi/animations
description: The oh-my-pi animation plugin suite — ambient animated TUI plugins (both waves) as a single config-driven package.

omp.name: oh-my-pi animations
omp.description: Ambient animated TUI plugins (both waves) as a single config-driven package.

animations.description: Shared motion tier for all animations (each still gates to 'off' on non-TTY/CI/NO_COLOR). Default 'subtle' is the curated native posture (Plan 007) for the 13 shipped animations; they mount as separate ambient rows.

sessionBonsaiPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Session Bonsai mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

sessionBonsaiAccentColor.description: Session Bonsai's primary accent — the active-path glow. 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

agentFleetPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Agent Fleet mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

agentFleetAccentColor.description: Agent Fleet's primary accent — the working-firefly color. 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

memoryCrystalsPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Memory Crystals mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

memoryCrystalsAccentColor.description: Memory Crystals' primary accent — the landing-flash sparkle. 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

auditTrailBoxPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Audit Trail Box mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

auditTrailBoxAccentColor.description: Audit Trail Box's primary accent — the box badge (the per-status risk ramp stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

diffBloomPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Diff Bloom mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

diffBloomAccentColor.description: Diff Bloom's primary accent — the added-side bloom segment (removed lines keep their diff-red). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

palimpsestPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Palimpsest mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

palimpsestAccentColor.description: Palimpsest's primary accent — the ember-tier glow at 4+ overlapping touches (underline/amber stay fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

goalHorizonPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Goal Horizon mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

goalHorizonAccentColor.description: Goal Horizon's primary accent — the milestone flare (the sunrise gradient stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

promptChargePlacement.description: Which side of the editor Prompt Charge mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

promptChargeAccentColor.description: Prompt Charge's primary accent — the full-charge flash (the dim-to-hot bucket ramp stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

sessionStrataPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Session Strata mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

sessionStrataAccentColor.description: Session Strata's primary accent — the generate (no-tool-call) segment color (the reused tool-category palette stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cacheMeterPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Cache Meter mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cacheMeterAccentColor.description: Cache Meter's primary accent — the badge color (the invalidation alert stays fixed error-red). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

driftBuoyPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Drift Buoy mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

driftBuoyAccentColor.description: Drift Buoy's primary accent — the buoy glyph (the strained-tether alarm stays fixed warning-amber). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Rate-Limit Tidepool mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolAccentColor.description: Rate-Limit Tidepool's primary accent — the water color (the near-empty sand alarm stays fixed warning-amber). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

fourHandsPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Four Hands mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

fourHandsAccentColor.description: Four Hands' primary accent — solid (in-context) human strikes (context-excluded hollow strikes and agent ticks stay fixed dim). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).
